Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameInterface, Serializable
public class Game extends Object implements GameInterface
Main implementation of the Galaxy Trucker game logic. Handles player management, ship creation, tile drawing, card drawing, and game state transitions.
